_comment: SHIPPED WITH THE PLUGIN. What a draft given to start or init with --from-failure must meet,
read by lib/door.mjs before anything is spawned (spec 727 AC-4, AC-5). Such a draft holds a
task as the person gave it, so it may carry a path, an email or a key by accident; the door
refuses one before the pinned CLI could write it into a committed suite, and names the place
and the class, never the value.
Every field is a copy, and the copy is asserted rather than trusted (spec 727 AC-6,
tests/plugin-compat.test.js): leak_classes is lib/hygiene.js PATTERNS, name for name and
source for source; email is the rule scanContent applies, with EMAIL_ALLOW and its .example
suffix; bounds are config.js's CASE_MAX_CHARS and SUITE_MAX_CASES and lib/skill.js's
SUITE_MAX_BYTES and CRITERIA_MAX; criterion_id is lib/skill.js's CRITERION_ID; origin_label is
lib/init.js's FAILURE_LABEL. A copy that moves without its source takes that test red.
It ships because an installed plugin has no lib/ to read these from, and the door runs the
check before the CLI, so the CLI's own bounds (which it still applies) come too late to keep
the draft out of the process that writes.
origin_label: drafted from a failure the person described and approved
